basic_details.job_title: Dredging Corporation of India Executive Director Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 45 years Age relaxation is applicable as per rules. Internal candidates get 2 years residual service, others get 3 years residual service as on the date of vacancy with respect to the date of superannuation.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate in Engineering / CA / CMA with good academic record. Management degree is an added advantage. Minimum 25 years post qualification experience.
qualification.details: Executive Director (Operations & Technical): Graduate in Engineering with good academic record from a recognized university/institution. Certificate of Competency as Master (FG) / Dredge Master Grade-I / MEO Class-I / Dredge Engineer Grade-I. Management degree from a reputed institution (added advantage). Minimum 25 years post qualification experience. Executive Director (Finance): Qualified CA or CMA. Management degree from a reputed institution (added advantage). Minimum 25 years post qualification experience.

salary_details.pay_scale: Basic: Rs. 1,20,000 - 2,80,000. Total CTC: Rs.50 Lakh - Rs.55 Lakh.
salary_details.details: Basic Pay: Rs. 1,20,000 - 2,80,000 Selected candidates will be granted Five additional increments on the minimum basic of Rs.1,20,000/-, i.e., Rs.1,39,130/- HRA, DA, perks and allowances, Leased Accommodation, Company vehicle, medical benefits, superannuation benefits payable as per the Rules of the Company. Total CTC: Rs.50 Lakh - Rs.55 Lakh at the minimum of the scale.

selection_process: Power Point presentation on achievements and plan for the applied position Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online through DCIL website: www.dredge-india.com under “Careers".
Website will be opened from 1000 hrs on 23.09.2026 to 2200 hrs on 13.10.2026.
Scanned copies of documents should be uploaded along with the application.
After submitting the application online, download the Application Form, sign it and upload along with Transaction ID of payment and testimonials/documents.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Dredging Corporation of India Executive Director posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Dredging Corporation of India Executive Director posts is 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the Executive Director posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Executive Director posts is 45 years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced by Dredging Corporation of India?
faq.answer: Dredging Corporation of India has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the post of Executive Director.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General category candidates is Rs. 1000/- (Non-refundable).

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Executive Director (Operations & Technical)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate degree in Engineering with good academic record or a Certificate of Competency as Master (FG) / Dredge Master Grade-I / MEO Class-I / Dredge Engineer Grade-I.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Executive Director position?
faq.answer: The salary includes a Basic Pay of Rs. 1,20,000 - 2,80,000, with a Total CTC ranging from Rs. 50 Lakh to Rs. 55 Lakh.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official website of Dredging Corporation of India.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Executive Director posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Power Point presentation on achievements and plan, followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any experience required for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 25 years of post-qualification experience is required for both positions.
